events.title: Darfur: Healthcare needs outstrip resources as Security Council extends Sudan sanctions
events.description: More than 700,000 displaced people in Tawila, in Sudan’s war-ravaged Darfur region, face severe shortages of healthcare, food, water and protection, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Thursday as it called for an urgent increase in resources.
